title: Holcim Is Acquiring Part of James Hardie’s European Business
summary: Holcim Ltd. is acquiring part of the European business of James Hardie Industries Plc for €840 million ($981 million), expanding its building, sustainable flooring and walling solution offerings.

title: Anthropic Set to Add Citigroup to Top IPO Banks on Mega-Listing
summary: Anthropic PBC is set to add Citigroup Inc. to the banks working on its initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, as Wall Street jostles for roles on the artificial intelligence firm’s debut.

title: J&J Snack Foods CEO on Snack Nostalgia, Turnaround Plans
summary: Dan Fachner, CEO of J&J Snack Foods, discussed the company's strategic focus on the food service segment, which accounts for 60% of its business. He emphasized the strong recovery and growth potential in experiential venues such as theaters, theme parks, and ballparks, where iconic brands like ICEE, Dippin' Dots, and Super Pretzel are popular. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fmr. LVMH Exec. Brown on Estée Comeback, Consumer Trends
summary: Pauline Brown, former chairman of LVMH North America, discussed evolving trends in the luxury market. She highlighted that while traditional luxury spending correlates with strong economic indicators like housing and low unemployment, today's consumers are more discerning. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ross Stores Raises Annual Profit Outlook on Robust Momentum

title: Bill Dudley Warns That US Stocks Are in Bubble Territory
summary: Bill Dudley, a Bloomberg Opinion columnist and former New York Fed President, explains why he thinks US the equity market is in bubble territory. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close," Dudley also comments on the economic impact of AI and the rise in bond yields. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: EM Currencies Mixed as Treasury Buyback Lift Proves Short-Lived
summary: Emerging-market currencies were mixed on Thursday as the US Treasury’s announcement of increased bond buybacks was seen by many as a “temporary” measure, allowing the dollar to rebound.

title: Orion180 Files for IPO, Eyeing Home and Flood Insurance Market
summary: Orion180 Insurance Group Inc. filed for a US initial public offering, as the company looks to carve out a bigger share of the fast-growing specialty homeowners and flood insurance market.

title: Vylor Raises $1.1 Billion in Latest Pre-Spinoff Bond Sale
summary: Vylor Inc. raised $1.1 billion Thursday, selling investment-grade bonds that will help finance a payout to soon-to-be former parent Corteva Inc.

title: Texas Is Tip Of A Melting Muni Iceberg: Winkler
summary: Bloomberg's Matt Winkler joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Borrowing costs for the state of Texas are higher than they are for California. The yield that investors demand on Texas bonds are, on average, point-3 percentage points higher than the Golden State. That adds up to as much as 3 million dollars annually for every 1 billion borrowed in Texas. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Aluminum Premium Slips as US Set to Cut Tariffs on Canada Metal
summary: A key regional price benchmark for aluminum delivered to the US market tumbled after the Trump administration indicated it would lower tariffs on certain Canadian exports of aluminum.

title: Risk Of Treasuries Selloff Is Growing: Robson
summary: Meghan Robson, head of US credit strategy at BNP Paribas, and Milwood Hobbs, deputy CIO of Oaktree’s Strategic Credit platform, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." US Treasuries fell a day after the Trump administration’s surprise decision to increase buybacks of longer-dated bonds, showing the move did little to counter angst about the surging government debt that pushed some yields to a 19-year high. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Stocks Fall as Oil, Yields Climb While Walmart Slumps
summary: US stocks fell on Thursday as oil prices and benchmark bond yields rose, while disappointing earnings from Walmart Inc. pressured shares of the retail giant and peers.

title: BlackSun Raises $1 Billion for New Sports and Media Fund
summary: Private equity group BlackSun has raised $1 billion for its inaugural investment vehicle, Mega Fund I, with the target of reaching $7 billion to invest across sports, media, entertainment and technology.
